heroHeadline: Pear Lake Fire Surges to 164,745 Hectares as Evacuation Orders Expand Along Highway 99
heroSubtitle: As of the federal government's 18 August update, 582 wildfires remain active nationally (31 out of control) across 4,793 fires and over 4.1 million hectares burned this season. The Pear Lake fire near Clinton, BC has grown to 164,745 hectares — now the season's second-largest blaze — prompting expanded evacuation orders covering nearly 200 properties along Highway 99 in the Marble Canyon/Pavilion Lake area. The Bald Range fire near Summerland has stabilized at 25,021 hectares after weekend rain, though 8 evacuation orders and 13 alerts remain in place. BC's province-wide state of emergency, declared 8 August, has been extended through 29 August as more than 150 wildfires continue burning across the province. Five deaths remain confirmed this season.
